Payment Terms
All payments shall be paid to the applicable Azure cloud marketplace. Payment will be made annually (at the
beginning of each subscription year) and as agreed between Customer and the cloud marketplace. Payment
will be made within forty-five (45) days of Customer's receipt of an invoice. To extent within CloudShield's
reasonable control and, to the extent Service Provider is required by Applicable Law to collect taxes for which
TechNova Solutions is responsible, CloudShield will separately state on the invoice the amount of taxes and the
jurisdiction(s) for which the taxes are being collected.
Notwithstanding the Agreement and/or anything to the contrary, Customer may not terminate this Order for
convenience.
